findings.violation: Four consecutive sentences jump subjects between employee actions and internal process descriptions without maintaining a topic thread. Reader must reorient between 'You record' (employee), 'Finance reconciles' (internal), 'Payroll releases' (internal), and back to 'you submit' (employee) at every sentence boundary.
findings.fix: Reorganize the section to group all employee-facing actions together, then describe internal process separately, or rewrite to maintain consistent subject focus within the paragraph.

findings.evidence: Line 11: 'one claim per employee per benefit year'. Line 60: 'The finance liaison publishes the equipment catalog at the start of the fiscal year.'
findings.violation: Document uses both 'benefit year' and 'fiscal year' for what may be the same or different time periods without clarifying their relationship. Reader cannot determine if a fiscal-year update affects their benefit-year eligibility or if these are distinct periods.
findings.fix: Use one consistent term throughout the document, or add a clarifying sentence defining the relationship between 'benefit year' (when employees are eligible to claim) and 'fiscal year' (when internal processes update).
